subject: Cross-cloud co-sell demo: propose window swap & APAC backfill
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Cross-cloud co-sell demo: propose window swap & APAC backfill

Vanessa / Brent —

Quick context: Nebula is ready to move forward with the joint marketplace showcase for the AWS co-sell motion. We have a Marketplace listing / validation milestone our GTM partner needs to hit next week, and they asked to shift the live demo we penciled for 7/16 into the week of 7/12 so AWS APAC contacts can attend during business hours.

Vanessa, I know you already have a full calendar that week — sorry for the short notice. Two asks:
- Can we swap the live slot from 7/16 to one of these proposed windows next week (see options below)?
- If your calendar is locked, can we plan an APAC backfill (pre-recorded walkthrough + 30m live Q&A) with Nebula and AWS APAC so the business milestone is met?

Proposed windows (UTC):
- Option A: Tue 2027-07-13 03:00 – 04:00 UTC (US-friendly morning, APAC late evening)
- Option B: Wed 2027-07-14 11:00 – 12:00 UTC (APAC morning, EU friendly) — our preferred
- Option C: Thu 2027-07-15 14:00 – 15:00 UTC (US afternoon)

Attachments: runbook v1 (nebulaws_runbook_v1.pdf) — quick ops notes and fallback plan.
Calendly for quick fill: https://calendly.com/redwood/co-sell-demo-nebula
Drive folder with slides & preflight: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCoSellRunbook

Brent — can you confirm Nebula’s presenter availability for the options above and whether they can support a pre-record + live Q&A fallback?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference | High-performance inference for product teams

Jonas —

Thanks for the heads up. I’m out of pocket on 7/13–7/14 for our Ops all-hands and a leadership offsite, so both Option A and B conflict on my end. I can cover Option C (7/15) but I’d prefer the APAC-friendly Option B since it helps the partner and AWS.

If we can’t free up my calendar, I agree with the pre-record + live Q&A approach as the fallback. Please loop in Enablement (cc’ing Kimberly) to confirm slide approvals and run the preflight checklist.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Got it — thanks.

Plan suggestion:
- Primary: move to Option B (Wed 7/14 11:00 UTC) if Brent / Nebula can present. Vanessa, would you be comfortable as moderator even if joining from mobile for the last 15m? No need for a full screen share if calendar constraints are tight.
- Backup: 7/15 14:00 UTC live with Redwood technical SME + Nebula presenter. If Vanessa unavailable, we run a 20m recorded walkthrough (hosted in the Drive folder) followed by 30m live Q&A with Nebula + AWS APAC.

I’m attaching the latest deck (co-sell_demo_slides_v3.pptx) and we’ll turn the runbook into the preflight checklist. Brent — any objection to Wed 7/14 11:00 UTC as primary? If yes, please propose a concrete alternative.

Jonas
From: Brent Miller <brent.miller@nebula-sys.com>

Thanks Jonas — Wed 7/14 11:00 UTC works for Nebula; Nathan and I will present. We can produce a 18–20 minute recorded demo by end of day Monday (7/12) as a fallback and join for an extended Q&A afterwards.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood share a short presenter call sheet (15m) + run order so Nathan knows the expected flow?
- We’d like AWS APAC on the Q&A — cc’d them.

We’ll accept the Drive folder invite and will upload the recorded MP4 to the shared folder.

Brent
